tinker.name: Unit Converter
tinker.description: Unit converter across seven measurement categories

zh-CN.name: 单位换算
zh-CN.description: 单位换算，支持七大测量类别

list.description: List measurement categories and their unit keys/labels. Call this before convert if you need valid type or unit keys.

convert.description: Convert a value between units. Updates the plugin UI. Omit to to get all units in the category; provide to for a single target.

value.description: Numeric value to convert, as a string (e.g. "1.5")

type.description: Measurement category. Defaults to the current UI selection.

from.description: Source unit key (e.g. m, kg, c). Defaults to the current UI selection. Use list for valid keys.

to.description: Target unit key. When omitted, returns all conversions in the category.

get.description: Get the current converter state: type, from unit, input value, and all conversion results.
